meta.title: The UAT Page at a Glance
meta.purpose: Use this when you check dashboard numbers on the UAT page and need the tabs, terms and tasks on one page

blocks.text: Use this when you check dashboard numbers during user acceptance testing (UAT), the last check before a dashboard goes live. Work through the three tabs in order.

blocks.caption: Labels on the UAT Page
rows: Open the result form; it stays disabled until every value is entered.
See each issue a Fail or Blocked result opens.
Change a completed card; its history is kept.

items: Enter a value for every scenario on **1 · Parameters** in plain language.
Refresh live values, such as open ticket IDs, when the page flags them.
Bring your legacy report or extract instead of estimating from memory.
Click **Record result** on **2 · Testing**; say whether it matched and enter both values and the report used.
For Fail or Blocked, pick a severity (how much it matters) and add a note.
Check **Issues found** for each decision: FIX REQUIRED, NOT A DEFECT or DEFERRED TO PHASE 2, with the reason.
Sign each dashboard off on **3 · Sign-off**.
Completed cards and passed tests turn gray, so anything not gray still needs you.
Sign-off warns you when tests have not passed or issues are still open.

blocks.text: Ask the business intelligence (BI) team member who runs your testing session.
